scripts.prebuild: if [ -z "$CI" ]; then security unlock-keychain -p anypic-local "$HOME/Library/Keychains/anypic-signing.keychain-db" || true; fi
scripts.postbuild: security unlock-keychain -p anypic-local "$HOME/Library/Keychains/anypic-signing.keychain-db" 2>/dev/null && codesign --force --deep --sign "AnyPic Local Signing" --keychain "$HOME/Library/Keychains/anypic-signing.keychain-db" build/darwin-amd64/AnyPic.app || true
